observed_strengths: warm sunset construction background supports cinematic tone
primary action is immediately visible through yellow emphasis
four-character foreground communicates people-first game identity
bottom image cards provide obvious secondary exploration routes
quick settings are visible without opening a modal
observed_risks: anime-style face templates can still converge unless face geometry and age cues are enforced
character captions and bottom cards compete vertically on shorter displays
company/project markings must use NEW PSI only; no real company names or random pseudo text
handwritten quote treatment needs live text, not baked text, for localization and readability

runtime_actions.action: move version/motto to upper-left and keep utility actions upper-right
make all five primary menu items icon + title + hint live controls
separate character quote overlay from live name/role caption
use real runtime artwork inside four bottom feature cards
show motion and quote toggles directly on the title screen
replace four character binaries with face-geometry-locked production art

production_rejects: readable real company/project logos or names other than the fictional NEW PSI brand
cropped helmet or missing signature prop in title composition
quote text baked into character image

branding.rule: NEW PSI is the fictional/development company identity. PSI : ZERO DAY remains the game title.
allowed_in_art: site sign or project board where a company name is needed
